items.description: Reset-under-traffic behavior and the first legal post-reset transfer are checked and documented.
Address/control and write-data stability pass under zero, single, long, and back-to-back wait states, with legal exceptions modeled.
Every supported HBURST × HSIZE × direction combination has legal address progression, alignment, wrap, beat count, and 1 KB behavior.
Two-cycle ERROR behavior is checked on first, middle, and final burst beats, including the master's documented cancel-or-continue policy.
An independent scoreboard proves no data loss, duplication, corruption, or target misrouting across stalls and errors.
IDLE and BUSY receive zero-wait OKAY responses, cause no side effects, and obey the selected burst-context rules.
Assertions, stimulus, and coverage match the exact AHB revision and every declared AHB5 optional capability.
All critical legal coverage holes are closed and every illegal bin or exclusion has a reviewed justification.
Implementation-specific latency, arbitration, and forward-progress guarantees pass under their documented environmental assumptions.
Representative failures produce readable waveforms and logs that identify phase ownership and the first violating edge.
